The HWPX document generation task succeeded by correctly manipulating XML structures within the OCF container to produce a valid event announcement.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and passed the legacy pytest suite in test_output.py. Success was driven by the accurate mapping of event data into the HWPX schema, though future iterations should verify XML namespace consistency across different HWPX versions. The judge_reward of 0.78 suggests that while functional, the document styling or metadata completeness could be further optimized.
